    - heading "Understand Sine Graph" [level=2]
    - paragraph: "The sine graph plots y=sin x against angle x. In Sine Graph, that statement is the exact rule used on the labelled chart and in the three numerical examples. A useful rule is Sine parent graph: y=sin x. You can learn Sine Graph by trying one small example instead of long theory."

    - heading "Graph y = 2 sin (½ (x − π/3)) + 1." [level=3]
    - text: Solution
    - paragraph: A = 2 → amplitude 2
    - paragraph: B = ½ → period T = 2π/(½) = 4π
    - paragraph: C = π/3 → shift right by π/3
    - paragraph: D = 1 → shift up by 1
